description: Synthetic conflicting reports: mom and dad report different bedtimes. Both items stay CURRENT with their own attribution — neither overwrites the other, no automatic winner, no silent merge. The conflict is surfaced by query on the shared topic; a resolution would be a superseding append, never an edit.

items.statement: Bedtime is 7:30 pm on school nights and she is asleep within minutes.
items.sourceQuote: 7:30 sharp on school nights and she's out within minutes.

items.statement: Bedtime is closer to 8:15 pm on school nights — the 7:30 attempt has never once worked.
items.sourceQuote: Honestly, 8:15 is the real bedtime. The 7:30 attempt has never once worked.
